integrity: The mathematical finding is the sharp asymptotic optimization across slice widths; numerical checks corroborate the general proof and do not establish infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite Johnson slices and first nonconstant harmonics only. Finite-width hypergeometric absolute-deviation collapse is prior known, not presented as new. The all-width optimal asymptotic is self-reviewed but not independently validated; full recent MAD literature has an acknowledged access risk.
title: The sharp worst-slice endpoint norm of the first Johnson spectral projection
